firstLaunch.license.htdemucsNotice: HTDemucs weights: maintainer adefossez wrote on 23 May 2022 (Demucs #327) that the weights “are not covered by the MIT license, and are provided only for scientific purposes”. Read on 2026-09-29. The audio.cpp card says “MIT, commercial use: yes” but no upstream source confirms it; that mention must not be read as the weight license. audio.cpp v0.9.1 code is Apache-2.0 (weights keep their original license).
